subject.title: Workboard: improve stacked-card readability and human-approval visibility

question: Should Workboard represent human approval/action-required cards as first-class card metadata/UI, a configurable prominent-label rule, or only the existing blocked/status/label convention?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the durable product contract affects UI semantics and possibly plugin config, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive product direction.

options.title: Add UI-local human-action signal
options.body: Surface a built-in attention affordance and count from existing status, metadata, notes, or labels first, without adding plugin config unless later proven necessary.

options.title: Add configurable prominent labels
options.body: Define a plugin-owned config contract for approval-needed label patterns, with docs and tests for the new user-visible config surface.

options.title: Keep blocked/status labels only
options.body: Document the current blocked status, labels, and filters as the supported workflow and close the first-class approval UX request as not planned.

recommendation.title: Add UI-local human-action signal
recommendation.body: Surface a built-in attention affordance and count from existing status, metadata, notes, or labels first, without adding plugin config unless later proven necessary.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest history-backed connection to the Workboard product surface and plugin metadata introduced by #85367.
